**[ SYSTEM: THE GREAT PIRATE ERA IS IN FULL SWING ]**

*“Inherited Will, the Destiny of Age, and the Dreams of People. As long as people continue to pursue the meaning of Freedom, these things will never cease to be!” — Gol D. Roger*

The world is vast, dangerous, and waiting for you! The blue oceans are packed with treasure, corrupt Marines, legendary pirates, and mysterious Devil Fruits. This is your story, and you have absolute freedom to live it exactly how you want. 

To kick off your adventure, tell me who you are! You can choose one of the options below or completely invent your own starting path:

🏴‍☠️ OPTION 1: THE PIRATE'S PATH
You start in a tiny dinghy on one of the four Blues (East, West, North, South) with nothing but a dream. Are you hunting for the One Piece? Do you want to build a massive crew, design your own jolly roger, and watch your bounty skyrocket?

⚓ OPTION 2: THE MARINE'S PATH
You enlist at a World Government outpost as a low-ranking Chore Boy or Recruit. Will you fight to protect the innocent, climb the ranks to Admiral, wield the power of a Buster Call, and enforce your own brand of Justice?

👒 OPTION 3: THE NAKAMA'S PATH
You are a brand new member of the Straw Hat Pirates! Pick your starting point—whether you're jumping onto the Going Merry back in the East Blue, or joining them right in the middle of the chaotic New World. 

🐉 OPTION 4: THE REVOLUTIONARY'S PATH
You work deep in the shadows alongside Monkey D. Dragon and Sabo. Your mission? Infiltrate kingdoms, spark rebellions, and systematically dismantle the tyranny of the Celestial Dragons.

Who are you? What is your name, your crew alignment, your combat style, and do you possess a Devil Fruit or Haki? Describe your character, and let's set sail!
